extraction_scope: Bounded mechanism ontology: computational design rationale and phenotype-level antimicrobial/safety validation only; no direct molecular killing mechanism is asserted by this paper.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper supports a CVAE-BIO computational discovery framework using biochemical constraints and an RF classifier to prioritize generated AMP candidates.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is a design/prioritization mechanism, not a direct molecular antimicrobial mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Wet-lab validation supports phenotype-level antibacterial activity for selected CVAE-BIO peptides, especially against E. coli, with exact MIC values available for the Table 1 subset.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: selected CVAE-BIO peptides and comparator controls

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=Antimicrobial profile of the selected peptides

mechanism_claims.limitations: No direct membrane disruption, binding, omics, or target-engagement assay is reported for the final peptides in this paper.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper uses human erythrocyte hemolysis thresholds at 50 µg/mL as a safety screen when identifying non-toxic active AMP candidates.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=Antimicrobial profile of the selected peptides:hemolytic toxicity paragraph

mechanism_claims.limitations: Aggregate threshold counts are text-supported; per-peptide hemolysis percentages were not text-extractable and are not inferred.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Local text/supplement tables support binary E. coli screening markers, exact Table 1 MIC values, and aggregate hemolysis thresholds, but not exact per-peptide growth-ratio or hemolysis percentages from figure images without unsupported image quantification.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Final activity layer uses source-supported binary/threshold and MIC values only; exact image-derived percentages are not invented.
